title: OAC 0.2 Undo request (JWS payload, typ oac-undo+jws)
description: The person asks the executor to take back one receipt's action. receipt = sha-256 of that receipt's compact token. Rules beyond the schema: exp - iat <= 900; mode must equal the receipt's undo kind; native and compensate only inside the receipt's until; compensate names the Consent (jti) for its new action.
